catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class fits one raw geometry_msgs/Twist velocity setpoint publication. cap.motion.mobile_base.v1 requires duration_s and returns distance_m, heading_rad and stopped, while the pinned /cmd_vel callback consumes a continuous Twist and publishes no completion, motion or stop acknowledgement. The binding sets linear.x, linear.y and angular.z; a rosbridge publication receipt is transmission evidence only.

No catalogue class carries a sensor_msgs/LaserScan observation. cap.sensing.point_cloud.v1 is a point-cloud capture action, not a passive 2D range scan, and no other class subscribes to a LaserScan topic. The package uses an extension read capability with an inline output schema.

No catalogue class observes a nav_msgs/Odometry topic as an explicit read; the odometry left the device resource because the p3d plugin publishes it from the Gazebo world update, which is silent while the e-stop holds the world paused, so the package exposes it as an extension read with an inline output schema.

WHAT WAS AUTHORED: a configuration-only ROS 2 RosDriver for the pinned Gazebo topic graph. The primary control is one x-cap.atharva-05.cmd_vel.v1 invoke action that publishes one geometry_msgs/msg/Twist to /cmd_vel, the topic subscribed by State_move_base with geometry_msgs::msg::Twist (unitree_guide2/src/FSM/State_move_base.cpp:87-90). The callback copies linear.x, linear.y and angular.z (State_move_base.cpp:81-85); getUserCmd passes them to setHighCmd (State_move_base.cpp:77-79), which writes them without clamping (unitree_guide2/src/FSM/State_Trotting.cpp:129-134). Resource reads expose pose and twist from /odom (README.md:50-53; the clone also has the p3d ground-truth plugin at go1_sim/go1_description/xacro/robot.xacro:220-227 and the ROS 2 estimator publisher at unitree_guide2/src/control/Estimator.cpp:123-127). One read capability exposes /scan (README.md:56-59), whose ray plugin remaps ~/out to scan and outputs sensor_msgs/LaserScan (go1_sim/go1_description/xacro/robot.xacro:185-217). /tf is documented (README.md:62-65) but not exposed. The README states the operator must start go1_gazebo, run junior_ctrl and press 5 for move_base mode before velocity commands act (README.md:32-36); the driver has no ROS observation of the active FSM mode, so this remains a deployment assumption. No Python native class is invented for the C++ nodes.

WHY THE HELPER CANNOT COMPLETE THIS SURFACE: the pinned clone creates no ROS service server and no ROS action server; it defines only messages. The passivation paths observed in the clone are internal: the keyboard maps key 1 to UserCommand::L2_B (unitree_guide2/src/interface/KeyBoard.cpp:25-42), State_Passive::enter sets the damping gains (unitree_guide2/src/FSM/State_Passive.cpp:9-48), FSM::run calls setPassive when its internal tilt check fails (unitree_guide2/src/FSM/FSM.cpp:38-45), and the SIGINT handlers call rclcpp::shutdown or clear a process-local flag (unitree_guide2/src/interface/IOROS.cpp:236-242, unitree_guide2/src/main.cpp:30-35). Defects: the docstring, facts.md and the fake said the estimator also publishes /odom and /tf, but both calls are commented out (Estimator.cpp:226-273); five facts said more than their lines (a 'tilt check' and a 'not a ROS service' clause, 'handles SIGINT' twice, 'publishes' for publisher creation, Go1Robot and the units off lines 149-151); and the package did not disclose Nav2's /cmd_vel remap (navigation.launch.py:118-127), the read failure on an inf or NaN scan range (probe), or the real-robot IOSDK interface, which cannot reach /cmd_vel at the pin (CMakeLists.txt:11-19, 40-42, 71-73; SDK library absent). The reviewer changed driver.py (docstring, five facts, seven source facts, four gaps), fake.py (comment), test_driver.py (a non-finite scan case) and facts.md, and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json; the gate fails only G6 and G8 as before with the stable digest unchanged (sha256:88e46e1294437b9a71b083ee700527936e223d2f0989870e37837bb5a348d242), and the ten package cases pass. The card needs the owner's publication decision (publish_review required; licence not stated (NOASSERTION)); the package may not be published or merged into a published tree before it. For the human reviewer: Gazebo 11 Go1 driven by unitree_guide2's junior_ctrl: /cmd_vel acts only after an operator presses 2 then 5 (move_base mode); there is no ROS stop, pause or reset, State_move_base keeps the last Twist, and Nav2 also publishes /cmd_vel. R2 is the author's choice: at the pin this binding has no real-robot path (IOSDK, a low-level UDP interface to 192.168.123.10 built with the safety object LeggedType::Aliengo even for Go1, compiles only without the ROS 2 move_base state, and the SDK library is absent). Unblocking needs an acknowledged stop, such as a citable Gazebo pause or an upstream service that switches the FSM to passive. No root licence; publish_review required.
